script.title: FOREST-1: Ewok Canopy Spaceport
script.description: A 1979 blue-and-grey explorer docks between living redwoods. Log command huts combine yellow space glazing, blue collars, thatched roofs and radar dishes. The detachable spacecraft has timber engine pods and leaf solar wings; four hooded forest astronauts maintain their treetop launch station and supply buggy.
